name: allows_restore_version_for_rollback
_comment: Verification can report damage after the write; without the rollback tool the skill can detect a regression it cannot undo.

name: does_not_allow_update_page
_comment: update_page is the destructive full-body replace this skill exists to avoid. Granting it would let the model fall back to the exact call that orphans inline comments.

name: warns_against_body_markdown_adf_path
_comment: body_markdown renders via ADF, which drops macro bodies and breaks image refs.

name: states_mermaid_is_not_rendered_here
_comment: Load-bearing boundary: rendering mermaid would mean shipping a headless browser in the MCP server.

name: requires_rendering_at_risk_anchors_before_asking
pattern: [Rr]ender the result in chat|render.*before asking|before asking anything

name: stops_batch_on_first_failure
pattern: [Ss]top the run on the first failed verification|one, verify, then continue
